description: Convert a bounded decimal or fraction quantity between explicit compatible mass, volume, international length, speed or item-count units. Reject incompatible dimensions; no density is inferred. (API Tool Calls, by Cowerx)

from.description: Explicit source or target unit. mm is millimeters; oz_av is avoirdupois mass; us_fl_oz is volume. US customary volume measures only.

to.description: Target unit in the same dimension. International length definitions and US liquid measures are explicit.

value.description: Nonnegative decimal (up to 24 digits, effective exponent ±24), fraction (1/2) or mixed fraction (1 1/2). Quantity and integer fraction components ≤10^12; denominator >0; proper fractional part for mixed values.

name: unit_convert

outputSchema.description: Parsed value, explicit from/to units and labels, dimension, factor, numeric result and reduced exactResult numerator/denominator strings, formula and NIST source URL. Numeric values approximate exact rationals.

title: Unit Converter
